verdict.rationale: Firebase documents its own Local Emulator Suite for integration testing and QA "without touching production data" across Firestore, Realtime Database and other services. That is a first-party isolated pre-production environment. Its official MCP server lets agents work with Firestore and SQL Connect data, but nothing ties these together into an agent-driven schema-change workflow. missing for 10: database branching or cloud preview environments, documented schema-change/migration tooling, evidence that an agent can create and test schema changes in the emulator or an isolated environment, a promotion-to-production flow, and independent corroboration.
